articles.title: Supreme Court bars government from post facto green clearance to projects
articles.description: The Supreme Court has protected projects worth Rs 20,000 crore from demolition. It permanently prohibited the government from granting post-facto environmental clearances. The court quashed a 2021 office memorandum that kept a window open indefinitely. Prior environmental clearance under the 2006 notification is now mandatory for all projects. The judgment will operate prospectively, validating past clearances granted under earlier rules.

articles.title: Adani Enterprises posts Q1 loss on US govt charge
articles.description: Adani Enterprises reported a net loss of ₹1,160 crore for the June quarter. This loss was due to an exceptional charge related to an OFAC settlement. Strong growth in airports and roads businesses boosted operating performance significantly. The company reaffirmed its capital expenditure plans for upcoming fiscal years. Adani Enterprises has no current plans to enter the airline business.

articles.title: Trump unveils $22 billion plan to remake Washington Dulles airport
articles.description: US President Donald Trump announced a $22 billion plan to rebuild Washington Dulles Airport. The project will replace concourses and add a large parking garage. This overhaul aims to transform the airport into one of the world's best facilities. The plan includes 5 million square feet of new or renovated airport space. Funding will come from municipal bonds and public-private partnerships.

articles.title: Rupee rises for the third day to a near 3-week high
articles.description: The rupee strengthened for a third consecutive day, reaching a near three-week high. Dollar sales by foreign and state-run banks aided the local currency's climb. Sustained buying in domestic equities and positive foreign investor sentiment supported the rupee. Crude oil prices saw a modest rebound, limiting further rupee gains. The currency is expected to trade within a specific range on Thursday.

articles.title: Bitcoin hovers near $64K after Fed decision; futures open interest hits 2-month high
articles.description: Bitcoin hovered near $64,000 after the US Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged at 3.50%-3.75%, while futures open interest climbed to a two-month high, signalling higher leveraged activity. Bitcoin traded at $64,062, up 0.26% in 24 hours, while Ethereum slipped 0.07%. Among major altcoins, BNB, Solana and Tron gained, whereas XRP, Dogecoin and Cardano declined.

articles.title: Indian techie moved to a European country with 2 suitcases: She opens up about salary growth, emergency savings and work culture
articles.description: Indian techie Ashwini shared the reality of moving to the Netherlands after arriving with two suitcases and limited resources. She revealed that finding accommodation was challenging, with her subsidised company stay costing 750-800 euros monthly. Working as a business IT consultant, she said her salary grew just 11% in four years, although the 30% ruling helped her save. Ashwini also highlighted Dutch workplace directness, slower career growth, high living costs and urged Indians to assess taxes, housing and savings before moving abroad.
